emails.subject: July all-hands agenda: topic submissions due Tuesday
emails.body:
Hi all,

We're building the agenda for the July all-hands, scheduled for Thursday 2026-07-23 at 4:00 PM in the 14th floor town hall, with dial-in for the remote folks. Catherine will open with a mid-year firm update, followed by Martin on first-half financial results and Linda on the operations roadmap.

If you'd like a slot for your team, please send me a one-line topic and the time you need (5 minutes max) by end of day Tuesday 2026-07-07. We're particularly looking for short updates on desk performance, the wealth pipeline, lending volume, and anything coming out of M&A that can be shared firm-wide without crossing any information barriers.

Compliance has asked that all slides go through Marcus's team by Friday 2026-07-17.

Thanks very much,
Wendy Dyer
Executive Assistant, Executive Office

emails.subject: Final agenda for today's all-hands (4:00 PM)
emails.body:
Team,

2. Martin, first-half financials and full-year outlook (12 min)
3. Linda, operations roadmap, including the KYC pipeline ownership move to Compliance planned for early October (8 min)

Wendy, please confirm the AV check is done and the dial-in link is in the calendar invite. Ravi, can your team have the overflow room ready on 12 in case we run over capacity?

Linda

emails.subject: Office lease renewal: options and decision timeline
emails.body:
Catherine, Linda,

I've had a first round with the landlord's broker on the headquarters lease, which expires in 2027. Three options are on the table:

1. Renew the full footprint for a 7-year term with a modest rent step-up and a larger tenant improvement allowance.
2. Renew with a reduction of roughly one floor, given the hybrid attendance patterns we've seen this year.
3. Relocate. I don't think this is attractive given moving costs and the trading floor's connectivity needs, but I'd like us to have a benchmark.

My recommendation is to pursue option 2 and use the sublease flexibility as leverage. I'd like to review the numbers with you both next week, and then take a recommendation to the board at the September meeting.

Linda, could you pull current desk utilization figures from Ravi's team? Wendy, please find 45 minutes for the three of us on Tuesday or Wednesday.

Best,
Martin

emails.subject: October all-hands agenda: submissions due Wednesday

Wendy Dyer
Executive Assistant, Executive Office

emails.subject: Re: Today's all-hands: a few changes to the run of show
emails.body:
Wendy, Linda,

A few changes for this afternoon's all-hands. I'd like to open with a short thank-you to the teams who worked through the quarter-end close and the KYC pipeline transition, since it was a heavy lift for Operations and Compliance. Please move my update ahead of Martin's so the financial context lands after that.

I also want to extend the Q&A to 20 minutes, even if it means trimming the department spotlights to three minutes each. Questions have been piling up in the feedback form and I'd rather answer them live.

Linda, please let Priya's colleagues in Technology know we'll acknowledge the upcoming engineering transitions briefly, with Sam to follow up directly with his team.

Thanks,
Catherine
